summary: Add guided teaching cards for all seven syllabus outcomes so learners can discover and check the reasoning already covered by the note, diagrams, and questions.

improvements.why: The syllabus gate reports no teaching card for any of the seven outcomes, although the chapter already has sound coverage, two diagrams, worked examples, misconceptions, and 79 questions.
improvements.what: Add one concise teaching card per KC with a discover question that asks the learner to infer the key idea before revealing a markable explanation. Use the existing nucleus and shell description, relative charge and mass table, $Z$ and $A$ definitions, mass and charge distribution, beam-deflection diagram, $A-Z$ and signed-charge counting method, and period/group and isoelectronic radius comparisons. Keep the existing pack and note content intact.
